amendments.before: Any app launch or local question
amendments.requirement: Build an explicit child environment that excludes NODEAGENT_ENDPOINT and fixes NODETASKS_CATALOG to the owned exported public catalog (or excludes it so the source default applies). Do not read, print or copy existing values. Do not alter parent/global environment. Assert the visible endpoint field is empty before chat. Block non-loopback application egress in the proof, while separately allowing normal recorded dependency installation.

Keep every fixture and sentinel beneath one newly owned retained scratch root. Put a benign deterministic sentinel outside fixture/upstream/noderoom but inside that root. Do not point to any real external/private file. Verify absolute resolved target before creating any file/link. Do not overwrite an existing destination or use recursive copy/move/delete of user paths.

Observe the actual delegated file read of the harmless sentinel in the unchanged validator, then require zero reads for the forbidden target after repair. Exit 1 alone is insufficient because failed assertions currently continue. Keep stale-receipt mismatch separate from the path cause. Include traversal, a blocked public-source name, and a supported known symlink/reparse target; retain platform inability as untested, not pass.

Validate the indexed path once before exists/read: expected canonical relative path under upstream/noderoom, no traversal/absolute/drive/UNC/backslash or alternate-stream escape, preserve existing blocked-name rule, reject an invalid entry immediately, and verify a regular physical target contained within the owned subtree. Handle parent links/reparse points, not just the final filename. Use existing Node filesystem/path APIs without a new framework or dependency. Do not claim concurrent hostile filesystem race protection from a lexical/realpath check; freeze inputs and reject source movement.

Bind exact PR1 export archive, every extracted Git blob, actual Node/isolated Python dependency versions and exact NodeKit launcher/registry input set. Keep dependency/runtime directories outside the scanned corpus. Preserve original receipt bytes and failed probes; use fresh fixture copies and restore only those owned copies. Bind the intended saved view, selected task IDs, top-N projection, reopened JSON bytes and local answer citations. Predeclare finite burst/sustained budgets. Source/code identity is not rendered equivalence; no UI edits without a new actual labelled before boundary.

limits: Static confirmation is not a program or rendered-UI replay.
The parent packet static arithmetic was byte-bound; this judge did not redundantly recompute all 9,155 task projections or 1,236 corpus hashes.
The source-export consumer and recorded dependency set do not exist yet. No execution identity is invented.
Original NodeTasks PR1 and PR2 remain intact; no wholesale branch merge approved.
AGENTS.md and AGENTS.override.md are absent from exact PR1 (read-only Git exit128 preserved in commands); the supplied user/global instructions apply.
The shared NodeKit executable and transitive checker inputs must be bound at execution; five registry/checker equalities alone do not certify an unrecorded launcher.
Endpoint-mode failure fallback prose is not certified by this no-provider first-use plan; do not imply endpoint integration was exercised.
No deployed/full-product/official-score/human acceptance claim or new grades.
